articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Fifth Third Debt Raise And Credit Shift Signal Evolving Risk Profile. Fifth Third Bancorp (NasdaqGS:FITB) completed a $2b senior unsecured debt offering, adding fresh long term funding capacity. The bank also announced a leadership transition in its credit organization, with a longstanding chief credit officer set to retire and an internal successor appointed. For you as an investor, the twin updates at Fifth Third Bancorp sit against a backdrop of a $50.22 share price and a 17.5% return over the past year.
